# MIRSAQ General Trading LLC

## Who we are
MIRSAQ General Trading LLC is a licensed electronics wholesale exporter based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, founded in 2022. We supply genuine, factory-sealed consumer electronics in bulk from Dubai to retailers, distributors, and resellers worldwide.

## What we sell
We are an authorised wholesale supplier of the following brands:
- Apple (iPhone 16 series, iPad, MacBook, AirPods)
- Samsung (Galaxy S25 series, tablets, wearables)
- Dyson (Airwrap, Supersonic, V15 Detect, Airstrait, Purifier)
- Garmin (Fenix 8, Epix Pro, Instinct 2 Solar, Forerunner series)
- Sony (PlayStation 5, headphones, cameras)
- JBL (speakers, headphones, earbuds)
- Xiaomi (smartphones, accessories)
- Nintendo (Switch OLED, games)
- Bose (headphones, speakers)

All products are 100% genuine, factory-sealed, and carry manufacturer warranty. We do not supply replicas or grey-market goods.

## Who we serve
- Independent retailers buying stock to resell
- Distributors sourcing brands not available in their local market
- Import/export businesses
- Salons and professional buyers (Dyson, Garmin)
Order sizes: single units through to full container loads — all sizes welcome.

## Where we ship
UAE (Dubai), and international export to: Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Belarus, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Georgia, and 20+ countries across CIS, Africa, South Asia, and Southeast Asia.
